Get them!'' :'''Snowman:''' ''Eat snow, vile servant of Grenth!'' == Notes == * This area contributes approximately 6.88 exploration points towards the [[Master of the North]] title track. * On rare occasions, you can see a group of [[Snowman|Snowmen]] fighting off [[Grentch]]es at the entrance of the abandoned village in the southeastern corner. If your party kills the Grentches, they will yield [[Norn Hunting Party]] points. * Watch out for [[ice boulder]]s in the northern parts. * There are 4 [[Jar of Healing Salve|Jars of Healing Salve]] at [[Egil's Perch]]. * There are more Vaettir in [[hard mode]]; some groups find it more efficient to bring a [https://gwpvx.gamepedia.com/Vaettir vaettir farmer] to deal with them. *{{Vanquisher|count = 271|low = 251|high = 290}} ** Pairs of hidden [[Frost Wurm]]s can spawn in six different spots in the northeastern quarter. If you wait to vanquish that section last, you might not have to kill any of them. The Mountain Pinesouls are hostile to these Frost Wurms. ** The patrol paths of [[Mandragor]]s and [[Minotaur]]s overlap in certain areas. ** There are [[pop-up|hidden]] [[Mountain Aloe]]s in the southwestern section. ** If [[Kilroy Stonekin]] spawns and you accept his challenge, there will be additional [[Stone Summit]] troops. ==Trivia== * [[w:Moraine|Moraine]] is the debris created by a [[w:Glacier|glacier]]. * The cartoon figure embedded in the map of Jaga Moraine is wearing a seal, [[Egil's Perch]], that may be a reference to the Thundercatshttps://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ThunderCats character, Jagahttps://thundercats.fandom.com/wiki/Jaga. {{Explorable areas in the Far Shiverpeaks}} [[Category:Easter eggs]] [[de:Jaga-Moräne]]
